original.question: Malo a Billie's chipinda chogona wamtundu wa mchembere ndi 360 makwata a mpira. Ngati kutalika kwa chipinda ndi 3 yadi(s), perimita ya chipinda ndi angati pa mpira?
original.answer:
Kutalika kwa chipinda ndi 3 yadi(s) * (3 mpira / 1 yadi(s)) = <<3*(3/1)=9>>9 mpira.
Kufupika kwa chipinda ndi 360 makwata a mpira / 9 mpira = <<360/9=40>>40 mpira.
Perimita ya chipinda ndi 2(40+9) = 98 mpira
